description: This file serves as a controller or router for handling various actions related to email routing rules within a SuiteCRM module. It processes requests such as setting rule status, saving, deleting rules, and retrieving metadata for rules and actions. It also includes initial setup and dependency loading relevant to email routing functionalities.

classes.name: SugarRouting
classes.description: Handles routing rules for incoming emails, such as setting status, saving, deleting, and retrieving rule data.

classes.name: SugarDependentDropdown
classes.description: Manages dependent dropdown UI components, providing metadata for constructing dynamic forms.

methods.name: setRuleStatus
methods.description: Sets the active/inactive status of a routing rule based on provided rule ID and status.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates a routing rule with provided request data.

methods.name: deleteRule
methods.description: Deletes a routing rule given its ID.

methods.name: getRule
methods.description: Retrieves data for a specific rule or initializes a new rule object if no ID is provided.

methods.name: getStrings
methods.description: Returns localized strings or metadata related to routing rules.
